name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-01-19, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
